about_the_game:
Explore and gain new abilities in the fantasy world you find yourself transported to in this short Isekai Metroidvainia inspired by modern classics in the Isekai and LitRPG genres. Fight monsters. Search for secrets. Uncover what caused the majority of the world's inhabitants to lose access to magic.

Features:

COMBAT

Defeat enemies that hinder your progress and take what they leave behind to grow stronger.

EXPLORATION

Use abilities you gain to explore new places and find secrets.

STORY

After a grueling day of work wondering why he even bothers anymore, a chance encounter leads to Jake waking up in a laboratory in an unfamiliar world encased in some sort of suit of armor.

Something went wrong with his transfer into the new world and his critical condition was stabilized by an affable genius who seems to be from another world herself. She wants to help Jake gain power and look into something for her.

The native inhabitants of the world are in turmoil due to recently losing access to magic. The loss seems to have happened around the same time Jake crossed over from Earth.

Jake's savior, Zara, seems to know more about what happened than she's letting on. Can she really be trusted?
